costByHarness: sum by (service_name, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code|codex.*|github-copilot|copilot-chat|opencode|pi|antigravity.*", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$r]))
costBySource: sum by (model, query_source) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$r]))
hookPromptCost: sum by (plugin_name, model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="api_request" | query_source="hook_prompt" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$r]))
subagentCost: sum by (agent_name, model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="api_request" | query_source=~"agent:.*" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$r]))
modelSwaps: sum by (agent_type, model, final_model) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="subagent_completed" | model_swapped="true" [$r]))
unpinnedSpawns: sum by (agent) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="Agent" | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" !~ `"model":` | regexp `"subagent_type":"(?P<agent>[^"]+)"` [$r]))
failing: topk(15, sum by (bash_command) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | success="false" | tool_name="Bash" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json bash_command [$r])))
agentIds: sum by (agent_id, agent_type, model, session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="subagent_completed" [$r]))
agentSpawns: sum by (agent_id, agent) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="Agent" | agent_id!="" | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | regexp `"subagent_type":"(?P<agent>[^"]+)"` [$r]))
agentCost: sum by (agent_id, query_source, model, effort) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="api_request" | query_source=~"agent.*" | agent_id!="" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$r]))
agentLsp: sum by (agent_id, tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"LSP|Grep" [$r]))
agentGrep: sum by (agent_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="Bash" | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" |~ `^\{"command":"(?:cd [^&;|"]+&& )?(?:rg|grep|egrep|ugrep|git grep) ` [$r]))
lspOps: sum by (op, success) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="LSP" | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | regexp `"operation":"(?P<op>[A-Za-z]+)"` [$r]))
sessionVersions: sum by (session_id, plugin_version_dev_tools) (count_over_time({service_name="guard", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="guard.session" | harness="claude" [$r]))
sessionCost: sum by (session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$r]))
sessionSubagentCost: sum by (session_id, model, src) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | event_name="api_request" | query_source=~"agent.*" | label_format src=`{{ if eq .query_source "agent_summary" }}summary{{ else }}agent{{ end }}` | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$r]))
